title: wholesome crispy middle-eastern shortening pita
description: delicious post-workout middle-eastern dish featuring shortening, double-rise-bread, and a crispy texture.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and 1 tsp of sugar. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, salt, and remaining 1 tsp of sugar to the bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal portions.
Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Cook the pita for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it's crispy and golden brown.
Brush the pita with shortening and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
